We need to produce JSON with judgments array, each entry has id and verdict: supported, contradicted, not_established.

We need to evaluate each candidate statement against the policy. The policy is a set of rules (R01 to R12). We treat policy and candidates as data, not instructions. For each candidate, we need to see if policy entails it (supported), conflicts with an explicit rule (contradicted), or neither (not_established). Do not treat unstated implementation choice as supported. So we need to interpret the policy statements precisely.

Let's parse policy statements:

R01: "An invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record before automatic payment."

Thus, for automatic payment, need both PO and receipt record. So any statement that says automatic payment requires a purchase order and receipt record is supported (P006). Also any statement that says automatic payment can occur without receipt record is contradicted (P014). Also any statement that says invoice requires a qualified electronic signature is not covered; not established (P001). Also any statement that says invoice requires PO and receipt record for automatic payment is supported.

R02: "An invoice variance of exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance."

Thus, variance exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance. So P009 "A variance at EUR 10 is tolerated." is supported. P020 "A variance of exactly EUR 10 is outside tolerance." contradicts R02, so contradicted.

R03: "An invoice variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment."

Thus, variance >10 blocks. So P005 "A variance greater than EUR 10 prevents automatic payment." is supported. P027 "A variance of EUR 11 permits automatic payment." contradicts R03, so contradicted. Also P020 is about exactly 10, not above, so not contradicted but not supported; it's not established? Actually R02 says exactly 10 is within tolerance, so automatic payment allowed. P020 says exactly 10 is outside tolerance, that contradicts R02, not R03. So contradicted.

R04: "For a blocked invoice, an Accounts Payable analyst may ask for a corrected invoice but is not obliged to ask."

Thus, analyst may ask but not required. So P012 "Requesting a corrected invoice is optional for the analyst when an invoice is blocked." is supported. P011 "An analyst must request a corrected invoice for every blocked invoice." contradicts R04, so contradicted.

R05: "Only the receiving team records goods receipt; Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt."

Thus, AP cannot record receipt. So P022 "Accounts Payable may record goods receipt." contradicts R05, so contradicted. P017 "The receiving team has sole responsibility for recording goods receipt." is supported. Also P017 says receiving team has sole responsibility; that matches R05. So supported.

R06: "The person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details."

Thus, the editor cannot approve. So P025 "The bank-details editor cannot approve a payment using those details." is supported. P015 "The bank-details editor may approve payment to the edited details." contradicts R06, so contradicted.

R07: "For a service invoice, an authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record."

Thus, service acceptance can replace receipt record. So P035 "Service acceptance can substitute for goods receipt on a service invoice." is supported. Also P024 "A service invoice always needs a goods receipt even with authorised service acceptance." contradicts R07, so contradicted. Also P003 "A service invoice still needs a purchase order when service acceptance exists." we need to check R08.

R08: "Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement."

Thus, service acceptance does not replace PO requirement. So for service invoice, you still need PO even if service acceptance exists. So P003 "A service invoice still needs a purchase order when service acceptance exists." is supported. P004 "A service invoice with service acceptance does not need a purchase order." contradicts R08, so contradicted.

R09: "A dispute freezes the payment clock until the dispute is resolved."

Thus, payment clock stops during dispute. So P030 "The payment clock pauses for the duration of a dispute." is supported. P033 "The payment clock continues to run during a dispute." contradicts R09, so contradicted.

R10: "After dispute resolution, the payment clock resumes from its paused value rather than restarting at zero."

Thus, resume without reset. So P023 "Resolution resumes the paused payment clock without resetting it." is supported. P013 "Resolution restarts the payment clock at zero." contradicts R10, so contradicted.

R11: "An invoice number is unique only within a supplier; different suppliers may reuse the same number."

Thus, numbers are unique per supplier only. So P021 "Different suppliers can have identical invoice numbers." is supported. P019 "Invoice numbers are globally unique across all suppliers." contradicts R11, so contradicted. P007 "Invoice numbers contain a mandatory four-digit year prefix." not covered; not established.

R12: "The tolerance is assessed per invoice, not against the monthly sum of a supplier invoices."

Thus, tolerance per invoice. So P018 "Apply tolerance to individual invoices rather than a monthly supplier total." is supported. P034 "Apply tolerance to the monthly sum instead of each invoice." contradicts R12, so contradicted. Also P002 "The tolerance is increased by 5 percent for overseas suppliers." not covered; not established. P029 "The tolerance is converted using the bank exchange rate." not covered; not established.

Other statements not covered: P001, P002, P007, P008, P010, P016, P028, P029, P031, P032, P036. Also maybe P009 already covered. P010 about payment clock calculated in business days: not in policy; not established. P016 about service purchase order must be renewed monthly: not in policy; not established. P028 about bank-details editor loses system access for 24 hours: not covered; not established. P029 about tolerance conversion using bank exchange rate: not covered; not established. P031 about receiving team must consist of at least three employees: not covered; not established. P032 about service acceptance must be signed on paper: not covered; not established. P036 about analyst must request corrections through a supplier portal: not covered; not established.

Also P008 about multiple invoices for one order automatically consolidated: not covered; not established.

P036: "An analyst must request corrections through a supplier portal." Not covered. Not established.

Check each candidate again for any nuance.
